name: opponent_handler
comment: entity handler 0x29 (opponents and the wingman): state 0 opponent_init; 1/2 ai_drive between sector-list unlink/link; opponent_effects when visible. Replaces the tentative entity_update_rim

name: opponent_init
comment: opponent setup: physics struct; upgrades (player's / skill / wingman entry); handling twice around ai_speed_curve; wingman_setup; race_start_setup. Replaces the tentative entity_reset_rim

name: ai_drive_car
comment: AI driving model: steer to driver +0x94; curve braking; lane changes; boost; catch-up or wingman throttle; wheel spin; ai_wheel_contact; walls without portals; one integration of 2*dt

name: ai_wheel_contact
comment: AI wheels on the ground: every wheel on the car's own sector; front wheels turn by +0x20 >> 8; no slip record

name: ai_speed_curve
comment: AI drive force at 20 wheel speeds into profile +0x26C (runs car_auto_shift with race phase 1; leaves phase 9)

name: seed_wheel_heights
comment: floor height under n points around the car into driver +0x4C.. and +0x6C.. (sector via find_camera_sector)

name: wingman_setup
comment: wingman globals 0x030061D4..0x03006200 for the race; gap per wingman 0x087F4284

name: start_lane
comment: lane 0..4 from the car's offset across the route (route_lateral)

name: nearest_on_line
comment: point of segment a-b nearest a point (64-bit products; __divdi3)

name: __divdi3
comment: libgcc 64-bit signed divide

name: race_gap
comment: how far an entity is ahead of a car along the lap; wrapped into -lap/4..3*lap/4

name: wingman_steer
comment: non-racer steering: +-0x400 towards the lane of *0x03006178 while 0x030061F0 is set

name: mark_blocked_lanes
comment: AI: lanes blocked by traffic just ahead on the main route and by racers close ahead after 0xB4 frames; returns its 3rd argument

name: next_racer
comment: next entity while the index is below the racer count 0x030057EC; else null

name: curve_lookup
comment: piecewise-linear curve (count; x0; x1; ys)

name: is_mode_e
comment: race mode 0x030056E0 == 0xE

name: is_mode_f
comment: race mode 0x030056E0 == 0xF

name: place_on_floor
comment: entity y = floor height; +0x88 = 0xFF; +0x64 = 0

name: ai_resync_segment
comment: AI stuck for 0x32 steps: route segment from the car's sector (track_segment without visited marks or side-to-side switches)

name: wingman_throttle
comment: the wingman's throttle from the player's lead; follow; attacker and drafter commands

name: wingman_follow_branch
comment: the wingman follows the player into a side segment from the fork

name: wingman_keep_gap
comment: wingman throttle keeping its gap to the player; a lateral gap over 0x200 ends the phase

name: attacker_command
comment: wingman attacker: catch the car at *0x03006178; then full throttle for 6 steps

name: drafter_command
comment: wingman drafter: run ahead of the player in its lane and refill the player's nitro (+0x2AAA per step)

name: traffic_handler
comment: entity handler 0x36: traffic (0 new; 1 lane driving; 2 removal; 3 knocked away)

name: traffic_find_sector
comment: sector of the query point: the query sector or one through a portal (dynamic walls never solid; solid only with material 0)

name: traffic_contact
comment: traffic car against the racers: bit 0 a racer near; swept tests; bit 1 hit (traffic_hit_response)

name: traffic_hit_response
comment: a racer hits a traffic car: impulse along the centres split by the traffic type's shifts; wobble; hunter drain; crash sounds for the player

name: traffic_bounce_walls
comment: knocked-away traffic car: its velocity bounces off solid walls within 100 units

name: clear_61f0
comment: *0x030061F0 = 0 if set (a non-racer hit a traffic car)

name: effect_handler
comment: (tentative) entity handler 0x34: the effect entities spawned in races (not ported)
